name: m3t6
description: Compressed-timescale scheduled week (SPEC §2.4 / issue #51): four housed founding adults (two pre-formed households, one house each) live seven 600-tick days under the day/night schedule system with NO commands ever submitted. Every day: the IAUS brain staffs gather work inside the 06:00-18:00 windows; end-of-work releases walk each Pop (staggered by the deterministic (eid, day) hash) to its household bed slot where a plain Wait holds them past nightfall; at 22:00(+jitter) the night band beds everyone with a Move/Sleep chain; 05:00 wakes pop the Sleep head exactly once and refill Rest by housing-quality x crowding (a perfect House night restores the full meter, so nobody is ever deprived here). Fixture pins milestone digests every 300th tick, the sampled daily arc (awake-and-working mornings/noons, all-asleep nights at home, rest refills), semantic gates (releases/beddings/wakes accumulate daily, deposits grow, no naps without deprivation), and doubles as the extended double-run determinism canary.
